summary: Master MarTech stack optimization and integration. Learn to audit tools, manage data governance, and maximize ROI. Enroll in our 5-day expert-led course.
lede: MarTech stack management training covers how marketing operations and digital transformation professionals assess and coordinate marketing tools, data, and workflows. Participants practice auditing tool inventories for overlap and technical debt, designing data flows and automated workflows, evaluating vendors with weighted scorecards, and calculating total cost of ownership to inform future technology plans.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the selection, integration, and performance of marketing technology ecosystems.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in marketing, IT, or digital operations. A working knowledge of at least one major CRM (e.g., Salesforce) or Marketing Automation Platform (e.g., HubSpot or Adobe Marketo Engage) is required. No coding or programming experience is necessary, but familiarity with data concepts like APIs and databases is beneficial.
